name: orbit
description: Dev process orchestration only. The apps live in backend/ and frontend/.

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names api,web,inngest,tunnel --prefix-colors blue,green,magenta,yellow "pnpm run dev:api" "pnpm run dev:web" "pnpm run dev:inngest" "pnpm run dev:tunnel"
scripts.dev:api: uv --directory backend run watchfiles --filter python app.dev.serve app
